links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of chatbot patient education responses by injury type
links.effect: Concussion responses mean grade level 10.80 vs sprain 8.13 (P<0.0001) and fracture 8.29 (P<0.0001); complex injuries had significantly higher reading grade levels.
links.quote: Concussion-related queries (mean: 10.80) had statistically greater reading grade level responses compared to sprain (mean: 8.13; P<0.0001) and fracture (mean: 8.29; P<0.0001) queries.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of commercial LLMs (ChatGPT 4.0 and Google Gemini) generating patient education materials for sports injuries, assessing accuracy, readability, and quality without testing an organizational deployment practice.
